_meta.purpose: Pool of attested personal names for unnamed NPCs (brief §9.1: never invent names; match to origin).

source.what: CDLI bulk ATF dump, Hallock PF texts (OIP 92) with CDLI English translations
source.file: https://github.com/cdli-gh/data (cdliatf_unblocked.atf, LFS sha256 2896ec25…d836, fetched via media.githubusercontent.com); catalogue cdli_cat.csv
source.coverage: 67 Persepolis Fortification texts only (PF 1–60, 400–406 = OIP 092 0001–0060, 0400–0406). No PT (Cameron, OIP 65) text is in the dump.
source.licence: CDLI terms of use (cdli.earth/terms-of-use, seen as a search extract only): data "may be freely copied, aggregated and re-used according to common and fair academic practice"; re-use of considerable data must cite CDLI. The cdli-gh/data repo has no LICENSE file. Transliterations/translations derive from Hallock, PF (OIP 92, 1969), which ISAC distributes as a free PDF. Cite: CDLI + Hallock PF no.

source.what: names of ordinary people cited with a PF or PT text in research/PEOPLE.md §2 (from search extracts of the Iranica articles and PT studies)
source.licence: the name forms and text ids are facts cited from the literature; nothing of the articles is bundled

_meta.method: CDLI: every {hal}/{munus} token in the 67 PF texts was curated by hand against the CDLI/Hallock translation line; genitive -na after kurmin ("supplied by") removed; titles and role nouns written with {hal} (kurtaš, sunki/EŠŠANA, mardam, kantira-ikkimar, akkayašeikki, {munus}abbamuš) excluded. Name = Hallock translation form (diacritics except š dropped). Origins (C): tools/names_licensed.py IRANIAN/ELAMITE element lists.

fields.count: CDLI: number of distinct PF texts in the dump with the name (null for EWB-only names).
fields.archive: "PF" = attested in a CDLI PF text (or cited PF text); "PT" = a cited PT text
fields.notable: name of a royal or top official; avoid for generic NPCs unless it is meant to be that person.
fields.role_in_text: what the person does in the cited PF texts (from the translation).

tiers.A: name form read in a primary text (CDLI transliteration of Hallock PF).
tiers.B: name form from a secondary citation of a PF or PT text (research/PEOPLE.md).
tiers.C: origin_guess: from an onomastic element in the spelling, not from an ethnic label in the text.

_meta.origin_values: Iranian | Elamite | Babylonian | West Semitic | Egyptian | Greek | Anatolian | Indian | unknown ("West Semitic" added for Aramaic-type names).
_meta.removed: D-193 (D-192, Q-294): the 484 names that rested on the EWB lemma base alone (DigitalPasts/ALP-MEGA2024, no licence stated) are removed, and the EWB lemma, page and etymon-based origin guesses of the CDLI names are stripped; the origin is guessed again from the spelling (tools/names_licensed.py). No woman's name is in the licensed evidence read (the one {munus} name in the 67 PF texts, abbamuš, is a title): women are unnamed (population.ts nameFor, sim.ts pickName)
